A gym built by its community

Power Beach is a free outdoor gym on Dasoudi beach in Limassol. Visitors write that the equipment was made with donations, that the place keeps improving and that it is open to everyone. On Google it calls itself Cyprus’ first beach gym.

What visitors say

Three of 90 Google reviews, 83 of them with five stars.

“An amazing spot in the heart of Limassol where you can swim and train at the same time! There is some pull-up bars, dips and hand-made gym equipment. Power beach is a motivational place for all nationalities that is full of amazing vibes!”

Google review
“Best place for an outdoor workout, fantastic community and shady trees for relaxing under after!”
